comment: Commits that CI and tools/golden.py use. math-exercise: the legacy sources of the goldens (math-exercise 0.10.0 on main; its checker library, question-tests.py and variants.py are byte-identical to the commit the capture was rendered with, which golden.py import-capture checks). ctm-assessment: the umbrella's Pyodide harness modules that tools/pyodide/verify.cjs uses (integration/pyodide-parity/runtime.cjs boots Pyodide in Node; wheels.cjs fetches SymPy, mpmath and NetworkX and checks them against Pyodide's lock file).
